title: MiniQMT daily execution depends on live RDAgent node asset fetch instead of frozen runnable package assets
description:
Expected: Once a StrategyPackage is enabled or bound for miniQMT execution, AIstock should have a frozen, locally runnable runtime asset set with manifest hash/provenance. Daily miniQMT selection/execution should validate the frozen assets and current market data, not require the RDAgent node 9000 mlruns-params endpoint to be available during the pre-open execution window. If a node fetch is required, it should occur during package preparation/binding and fail before the trading deadline.
Actual: StrategyPackage live_inference intentionally calls _materialize_runtime_source_from_node(... allow_cache_fallback=False), and node download_mlruns_params failures such as mlruns-params 404 fail hard. This no-silent-cache behavior is correct for reproducibility, but when the same path is used in daily miniQMT pre-open execution it can make a previously selected strategy operationally depend on remote node availability at the worst time. Operators observed RDAgent 9000 mlruns-params returning 404 during asset preflight analysis.
required_verification: Unit/integration test: after package materialization, simulated RDAgent mlruns-params failure does not block daily miniQMT preflight when frozen runnable assets exist and hashes match.
Unit/integration test: missing or corrupt frozen runnable asset fails fast before the trading deadline with actionable provenance context.
Regression test: no silent cache fallback is introduced; any fallback or local asset usage records explicit origin/provenance.
Package binding test: miniQMT binding captures manifest hash, runtime asset hash/provenance, and trade-date selection evidence.
Operational validation: daily miniQMT run path distinguishes package preparation/materialization failures from current-day market data readiness failures.
closure_requirements: StrategyPackage enable/binding stage materializes and verifies runnable assets before daily execution.
Daily miniQMT execution uses frozen AIstock-managed assets by hash instead of depending on live RDAgent node availability.
Operator-facing errors clearly state whether the blocker is package asset preparation, current market data, or broker readiness.

events.note: This issue should preserve no-silent-fallback semantics. It should not silently use stale cache when node fetch fails.
Business impact: P1 because node availability or mlruns-params 404 can block morning miniQMT execution even when the operator expects an already prepared StrategyPackage to run.

Expected design: separate package preparation/materialization from daily execution. The binding or enable step should freeze and verify runtime assets; the daily miniQMT runner should use those assets by hash and fail only if the frozen assets are missing/corrupt or current market data is not ready.
Relationship to BUG-047: BUG-047 fixed factor lookback window sizing; this issue is about operational asset authority and RDAgent node dependency, not factor window length.

Required verification: simulate node mlruns-params failure after package materialization and prove daily miniQMT preflight can run from frozen AIstock-managed assets with provenance; simulate missing frozen asset and prove fail-fast before trading deadline.
